name: worktree-boundary-tests
body:
The opt-in suite e2e `opencode-suite/tests/boundary.e2e.test.ts` as the surface that pins the worktree write boundary: a code-writer fs-op whose path resolves into the main checkout is refused whatever `directory` is passed, the matching worktree path inside a worktree-rooted grant succeeds, and `..`/absolute escapes stay refused. Deliberately a NARROW owner (implemented-by exactly this one file) so `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check` maps the requirement's coverage 1:1 to the edited test surface.

implemented-by: `opencode-suite/tests/boundary.e2e.test.ts`.
